profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
A well-rounded engineer with experience building and owning infrastructure products from the ground up. 

Currently working on Observability as Code @ Airbnb. 
Previously worked on Vector & Observability Pipelines @ Datadog and Observability @ Lyft.

Also an avid runner and snowboarder - fun fact, I’m in my cover photo.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding engineer. 
Worked closely with Product to identify product market fit through agile iteration, competitive research, and user studies. 
Effectively grew the team from one to four engineers, establishing the foundations of the technical culture.
Developed the company’s first two product offerings and the foundations of its core algorithms as they exist today.

positions.title: Stat110 Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
Developed and taught a new computer science focused weekly section. 
Held weekly office hours. 
Graded and gave timely feedback on exams and assignments.

Core Topics Taught: Probability, Random variables, Univariate/Multivariate distributions, Limit theorems, Markov chains.
